prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Adoption new screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Choose path redesign changes can be helpful (1 test won), though 3 tests showed no clear effect; evidence is still thin for finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.
Positive predictions were generally too high (with a few exceptions), while negative predictions were too low as all tests predicting negative results measured positive outcomes after noise correction.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -2.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.8% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_flow] Story Path Interactive Animation Flow: Introduce an animated mascot story flow with interactive path choice prompts before making the main selection. (why: Choose path has a high mean duration (514s); interactive story presentation helps orient users quickly, where previous path redesigns saw positive signal.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign In Stage Reorder: Move sign_in after pet adoption and customization screens so users build emotional connection before account creation. (why: Sign in currently loses 27.1% of users early; moving sign_in later lets users pick their pet first, raising commitment.)
2: [home, hint] Waiting Stage Background Generation Hint: Display a dynamic hint on the waiting screen reassuring users that pet generation runs safely in the background. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s, creating anxiety about app responsiveness during creation.)
3: [home, notification] Pet Generation Desktop Completion Alert: Enable desktop notification toggles on the waiting screen when custom pet rendering is complete. (why: Mean time spent waiting is 2336s, leading users to abandon the app thinking it stalled.)
4: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Pet Style Clarity Copy: Update photo upload headline and helper text to provide clear formatting requirements for custom pet creation. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet appearance, contributing to the 60.9% adoption conversion.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Live Process Stage Banner: Add a step-by-step progress component showing generation stages (3D Mesh, Textures, Behavior) during waiting. (why: Median waiting time is 201s with a high mean (2336s); showing active progress reduces perceived waiting drop-off.)
6: [finish, layout] Home Intro Split Welcome Layout: Switch home intro screen layout to split view, separating the welcome mascot from final launch instructions. (why: Finish stage drops 35.2% of users; a split layout clarifies the transition from onboarding into desktop launch.)
